saw_lines: Beauty buyers try one product, then judge the whole brand by whether the results show up in the first weeks.
So the proof must sit in the ad, since a new stranger will not dig through a long product list.
Your site shows 30,000+ reviews and a 4.7 rating, yet the Google text ads we could read use neither. Open the next batch with the 4.7 rating on the creative.
ads_1: Google text ads that lead with the 4.7 rating and the Peptide SPF 50
